Applet.Name: BSimAuth
Applet.Description: Purpose-bound BSim authentication and provisioning applet contract

buildProvisioningEnvelopeV3.Name: buildProvisioningEnvelopeV3
buildProvisioningEnvelopeV3.Description: Validate one canonical signed BootstrapPacketV3 and return the canonical opaque provisioning result packet.

ensureKeyFootprintV1.Name: ensureKeyFootprintV1
ensureKeyFootprintV1.Description: Issuer-only: ensure the BSimID two-key footprint (Kprov 0x0010, AUTH 0x0011) exists and return both canonical SPKIs with their generations.

getAuthAppletInfo.Name: getAuthAppletInfo
getAuthAppletInfo.Description: Return the fixed AuthAppletInfoV1 fields used by provisioning and authentication transcript hashes.

getAuthenticationIdentity.Name: getAuthenticationIdentity
getAuthenticationIdentity.Description: Create or read the Auth key and return canonical P-256 SPKI, its SHA-256 fingerprint, and the credential generation.

personalizeTrustAnchorV1.Name: personalizeTrustAnchorV1
personalizeTrustAnchorV1.Description: Issuer-only: install the canonical 224-byte root anchor (rootEpoch || rootSpki[91] || rootSki[32] || rootSubjectHash[32] || cardIntermediateSki[32] || serverIntermediateSki[32] || allowedPurposes) through ANCHOR_SET_ACCEPT and return the accepted AnchorStateV1.

putCertAdmV1.Name: putCertAdmV1
putCertAdmV1.Description: Issuer-only: put one Cert_adm leaf (DER; SPKI == AUTH SPKI, EKU id-kp-bsim-admission, no id-bsim-iccid) for the personalized anchor at the AUTH address 0x0011 through CERT_PUT_BEGIN/CHUNK/COMMIT and return the certificate generation and leaf SHA-256.

putCertSimV1.Name: putCertSimV1
putCertSimV1.Description: Issuer-only: put one Cert_sim leaf (DER) for the personalized anchor at the Kprov address 0x0010 through CERT_PUT_BEGIN/CHUNK/COMMIT and return the certificate generation and leaf SHA-256.

readKprovPublicationReceiptV1.Name: readKprovPublicationReceiptV1
readKprovPublicationReceiptV1.Description: Issuer-only: return the Core-signed KeyPublicationReceiptV1 for Kprov (0x0010), zero-padded to 176 bytes with its length prefixed.

signAdmissionV1.Name: signAdmissionV1
signAdmissionV1.Description: Validate and sign only a canonical AdmissionTranscriptV1 (object 0x09, purpose admission) under the AUTH key, then return the signature followed by AdmissionEvidenceV1 (Cert_adm leaf || card-issuance intermediate) read from the AUTH address 0x0011; 6A88 when no Cert_adm is stored.

signAuthKeyPossessionV1.Name: signAuthKeyPossessionV1
signAuthKeyPossessionV1.Description: Issuer-only: validate one canonical AuthKeyPossessionV1 (object 0x0A, purpose admission-pop) whose authSpki equals PUBLIC_KEY_READ(0x0011) and sign it under the AUTH key; the proof of possession the issuer requires before issuing Cert_adm.

signAuthenticationChallengeV1.Name: signAuthenticationChallengeV1
signAuthenticationChallengeV1.Description: Validate and sign only a canonical authentication-challenge transcript V1; never sign arbitrary bytes.

signAuthenticationSessionV1.Name: signAuthenticationSessionV1
signAuthenticationSessionV1.Description: Validate and sign only a canonical authentication-session transcript V1; never sign arbitrary bytes.

signMigrationIntentV1.Name: signMigrationIntentV1
signMigrationIntentV1.Description: Validate and sign only a canonical current-key migration-intent transcript V1; never sign arbitrary bytes.

SW_ANCHOR_REPLAY.Name: SW_ANCHOR_REPLAY
SW_ANCHOR_REPLAY.Description: Relayed KeyVault REPLAY: same-epoch anchor conflict or lower-epoch rollback

SW_CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND.Name: SW_CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND
SW_CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND.Description: Required compatible credential or evidence is unavailable

SW_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.Name: SW_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE
SW_DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE.Description: Required Crypto Primitives or KeyVault SIO is unavailable

SW_INVALID_DATA.Name: SW_INVALID_DATA
SW_INVALID_DATA.Description: Invalid canonical encoding, digest, point, or conflicting replay

SW_INVALID_LENGTH.Name: SW_INVALID_LENGTH
SW_INVALID_LENGTH.Description: Invalid APDU, field, packet, or canonical object length

SW_KEYVAULT_IDENTITY.Name: SW_KEYVAULT_IDENTITY
SW_KEYVAULT_IDENTITY.Description: Relayed KeyVault IDENTITY: leaf SPKI differs from the key at the put address

SW_KEYVAULT_POLICY.Name: SW_KEYVAULT_POLICY
SW_KEYVAULT_POLICY.Description: Relayed KeyVault POLICY: key profile without certificate profile or usage

SW_KEYVAULT_QUOTA.Name: SW_KEYVAULT_QUOTA
SW_KEYVAULT_QUOTA.Description: Relayed KeyVault QUOTA: anchor or certificate quota exhausted

SW_KEYVAULT_RESERVED.Name: SW_KEYVAULT_RESERVED
SW_KEYVAULT_RESERVED.Description: Relayed KeyVault RESERVED: reserved anchor id or literal

SW_NO_MEMORY.Name: SW_NO_MEMORY
SW_NO_MEMORY.Description: Bounded transient workspace cannot be reserved

SW_WRONG_STATE.Name: SW_WRONG_STATE
SW_WRONG_STATE.Description: Operation or stream is not valid in the current state
